title: Database backups
subtitle: Versioned, gzip-compressed snapshots of every SQLite database — the global registry and each app's app.db. Runs daily and keeps the configured retention window.
disabledHint: Scheduled backups are OFF (STREAMHUB_BACKUPS_ENABLED=false). You can still create manual backups with the button, but there will be no automatic daily snapshots.
envHint: Configuration is env-driven: STREAMHUB_BACKUPS_ENABLED, STREAMHUB_BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS, STREAMHUB_BACKUP_DIR and STREAMHUB_BACKUP_CRON — see operations/BACKUPS.md.

snapshots.empty: No snapshots of this database yet. Use “Back up now” or wait for the daily run.

restore.title: Restore backup
restore.summary: You are about to restore {{db}} from snapshot {{file}}.
restore.warnOverwrite: This OVERWRITES the current database: every change made after the snapshot is lost.
restore.warnSafety: A safety backup (.pre-restore) of the current state is auto-created first — you can roll back by restoring it.
restore.warnIntegrity: The snapshot is validated (gunzip + PRAGMA integrity_check) BEFORE the swap; a corrupt snapshot leaves everything untouched.
restore.warnGlobal: This is the GLOBAL registry: after restoring, a core restart is recommended to rebuild in-memory state (permissions, caches).
restore.restartRecommended: The global registry was restored: restart the core (docker compose restart core) so in-memory state is rebuilt.
